Posting to 4chan works again, plus saved threads, an app lock, a new video player setup and a new icon.

**Fixed**
- Replies to 4chan can be posted again. 4chan dropped Google reCAPTCHA, so the captcha screen now runs 4chan's own captcha (slider, cooldowns and the Cloudflare check included). On Android 6 it asks you to update Android System WebView
- Reverse image search: Google goes straight to Google Lens, Yandex runs the search again, iqdb and TinEye use https, and flash files search their thumbnail instead of crashing

**New**
- Save for offline: a thread's menu can save it with all its images and videos. Saved threads are in the drawer under "Saved threads", open without a connection, and can keep updating with new posts
- Deleted 4chan threads: when a thread is gone, Clover Neo looks it up in the archives that keep that board (4plebs, Desuarchive and others) and shows it with a note saying where it came from. It can pass an archive's Cloudflare check in the app. Turn it off with Behavior → Load deleted threads from archives
- App lock: Behavior → Privacy → Lock the app asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock when the app opens or comes back after a while you choose
- Hide from recent apps: shows a blank preview in the app switcher (on Android 12 and older this also blocks screenshots)
- Private image search: opens image searches in an incognito tab that keeps no history or cookies (needs a recent Chrome)
- Video player settings: Settings → Media → Video player. Controls are now a bar at the bottom with a wide seek bar, double-tap skips back or forward, and you choose when controls show and how long they stay up
- Export settings: saves your sites, boards, bookmarks, history, filters and settings to a file. Restore it with Settings → Import backup (which also still reads a Clover backup)
- A new launcher icon of its own, with themed icon support on Android 13 and newer

**Removed**
- 8chan and arisuchan, which are offline. They are removed from existing installs on start
- The 4chan "Captcha type" setting, since both options used the retired reCAPTCHA

Saved threads change the database, so after updating you can't go back to v3.2.0 without clearing the app's data.
